snippet.title: Boxes Go Wild – Raise the Roof! (Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description:
One game, from the first three rows to the top. Stack the crates, chain the merges, fill the PRESSURE gauge and watch the pistons lift the board, until you RAISE THE ROOF.

Boxes Go Wild is a free number merge puzzle where the board rises with your score: tap a column, merge equal numbers to double them, chain merges for big scores, blast the bottom row with STEAM BLAST, break cursed crates and climb the weekly and world leaderboards. Plays offline.

Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kipyo.boxesgowild&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dtrailer
Website: https://boxesgowild.com
